scripts/lib/paid-report.ts.nonBehavioral: a case shard's result records are attributed to its one case: the trial's cost_usd and cost_known come from them, and a failed trial's failure_class, exit_reason and error come from its record instead of a bare assertion with the JUnit message, so a red whose record says infra or timeout is classed by that record (INFRA instead of VERDICT: rerun and bisect eligibility, not a pass rate); no case's outcome or selection changes and pass rates count outcomes only, so no pass-rate series resets
